title: Accessibility and keyboard-only enterprise UX gate
goal: Make AegisPT usable and testable for keyboard-only and assistive-technology users, with WCAG AA as the minimum product-quality bar.
scope: Create a dedicated accessibility acceptance gate for the operator console. Audit and fix keyboard navigation, visible focus, focus trapping in modals/drawers, Escape behavior, aria-labels/names for icon buttons, form labels/help text, color contrast, reduced-motion behavior for Cinema/scan maps, and screen-reader-friendly empty/error states. This complements general IA work; it is a specific WCAG/keyboard gate.
generation_reason: Existing UI tasks mention clarity and accessibility generally, but enterprise readiness needs a concrete accessibility gate. The product has many icon buttons, animated surfaces, drawers, modals, dense cards, and status badges that need keyboard and assistive-technology proof.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Accessibility acceptance and fixes only. Do not redesign app architecture or change backend runtime behavior.

success_criteria: Keyboard-only navigation reaches all primary screens, primary actions, drawers, and modals in logical order.
Focus is visible and never lost after opening/closing drawers, modals, Cinema Mode, or wizard steps.
Icon-only buttons have accessible names and do not rely on color alone.
Core text/status contrast meets WCAG AA; exceptions are documented and corrected.
Reduced-motion mode disables or substantially calms live animation surfaces.
Automated and manual accessibility evidence is recorded under codex/results/.

acceptance_criteria: A keyboard-only user can launch a safe local assessment path and inspect output without pointer input.
Known animated surfaces honor reduced-motion preference.
Accessibility findings are recorded with screenshots or DOM evidence.

before_promotion: NEXT_TASK.md must contain this task as the only active task.
after_completion: Promote exactly one next approved task into NEXT_TASK.md.

out_of_scope: Screen-reader certification by an external auditor
